_note: S2 asks for 'the release-date table for the model line'. That table
is NOT AVAILABLE in this environment: the egress policy is an
allowlist and the publisher's release notes are not reachable, and a
table carried from memory is the status this repository records as
ANC_010 / CD_009 / RD_015 / HO_005 -- carried, unverified, and not
So this file ships the substitute the repository can produce itself,
and labels it as one. Each row is an OBSERVED BOUND, taken from the
Co-Authored-By trailers already in this repo's git history. An
observed first appearance is an UPPER BOUND on a release date and is
never the release date: the model existed at least that early, and
may have existed much earlier with nobody committing under it.
Every decode produced from this table inherits that. The decoder
prints the inheritance on every run rather than in a footnote.
To use real release dates: replace the rows, set kind to
'release_date' and source to the publisher's page. The decoder reads
kind and changes what it says about the result; it does not need any
source: git log trailers, this repository, read 2026-08-25
